name: Hardware Corner: RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, llama.cpp CUDA, Qwen3 8B Q4_K GGUF, token generation (tg) 25.8 t/s @64k ctx
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (hardware-corner.net per-GPU LLM page, March 2026 update, accessed 2026-10-16). llama.cpp CUDA, single GPU, batch 1. RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, Qwen3 8B Q4_K GGUF. Grid cell is token generation (tg) at the 64k-context column (~65536 tokens). Per-request, not summed across concurrent requests. Q4_K is the lab label; nearest repo format is gguf-q4-k-m. Prompt length inside the column is the context tier, not a separately published pp512.
notes: Context-sweep companion to the 16k decode rows from the same lab ranking page. Hero callouts that disagree with the grid (4070 Ti SUPER 84.3 t/s copies the PRO 5000 callout) are not used; this is the grid cell.
